title: Malicious code in @lekzoz/baileys (npm)
description: The npm package '@lekzoz/baileys' contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or running. The presence of this package indicates a full system compromise, potentially exposing all stored secrets and keys. Immediate rotation of all secrets and keys from a separate, uncompromised system is advised. Removal of the package alone may not eliminate all malicious components due to possible persistent backdoors or additional malware installed.
